steps.name: boot-refusals
ac: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/harness/test_execute_boot.py -q
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/harness/test_execute_boot.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 4
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check tests/harness/

steps.name: context-builders
ac: cd apps/api && uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/harness/test_execute_boot.py -q
cd apps/api && test "$(uv run --env-file .env.local pytest tests/harness/test_execute_boot.py --collect-only -q 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')" -ge 8
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check tests/harness/
